notes.title: Holiday 2024 Update
notes.notes: Fixed some bugs, added some Holiday fun to the mix. Enjoy.

notes.title: Thanksgiving Update
notes.notes: This is an update for Thanksgiving holidays. Some mini-games to play and bug fixes and optimizations.

notes.title: Update for October 2024
notes.notes: Updates and Halloween Time 2024.

notes.title: Easter Update
notes.notes:
It's that time again, the Great Easter Egg hunt is on! Climb the leaderboards with your super Egg hunting skillszzzzz. The Bunny might have left something in the store also.  And the bunny was hard at work optimizing stuff so it runs better. So you can blame the bunny is it doesn't work, or maybe it was the Leprechauns from St. Patrick's day that left gremlins around. If you see any send in a report and we will clean it right up. :)
Have fun.

notes.title: St. Patrick's Update
notes.notes:
The Green Holiday is upon us. There is Gold at the end of the Rainbow, if you can keep those little Leprechauns from hiding it all. Enjoy the Holiday surprises.
Also added cross platform characters so you can login on different devices with the same character and keep your stats and all.
Optimized some levels.

notes.title: Jan-Feb Update
notes.notes:
New year awaits your game play. Join in the fun. Improvements and updates. Classroom functions for schools to connect and play together. 
Game name changed.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Updates
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue with Friends and players coming and going. Added Person to unlock Friends button in main Hub for now. Fixed issue with logging in when account is not valid. Changed saving clothes to save to proper files and fixed network issues for changing clothes.
Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Small Halloween update patch.
notes.notes: Made the main Hub a little more spooky. Also check out the NPC on the stage, he can tell you how to become a Rockstar!

notes.title: Halloween 2023 Update
notes.notes: It's that time of year again! It's the fun Halloween party update! Get costumes and go to spooky Transylvania!  Do the Spooktober quest in the main Hub to get your ticket for the Party!

notes.title: July Patch Notes
notes.notes: Added a new Mini Map System. You will now more easily be able to find quest items in the general area. Also new quest givers. Bug fixes.

notes.notes: Fixed mini concert tutorial and camera stuck on NPCs. cleaned up some bugs and code.

notes.title: Easter Event Patch and Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Easter is here and so is Easter Egg hunting. Join in the fun and find the most easter eggs. Get the top score on the Leaderboards. Go to the hub to play the Easter Egg Hunt event.
Also added Map zoom. made it easier to select flags and a popup list of countries to use, you can find the button on the map.
Added some Easter items in the store. 
Fixed some bugs.
Scroll text is now added to the dialog boxes.

notes.title: Bug Fix Updates
notes.notes:
Fixed some travel quests not ending. Fixed some item locations and sizes for quests. 
Added more descriptive text for quests.
